selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent configuration and zero live values for all, default, eth0, and lo, including after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows Alpine Linux v3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
selected_evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, then recovered networking and persistent hardened state.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- os-release ---'
cat /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- kernel ---'
uname -r
printf '%s\n' '--- boot-id ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- target sysctls ---'
for key in net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; do sysctl "$key"; done
printf '%s\n' '--- sysctl config locations ---'
ls -ld /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- matching persisted settings ---'
grep -R -n -E 'accept_(redirects|source_route)' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- init and enabled services ---'
ps -p 1 -o pid=,comm=,args=
rc-status -a 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 022
cfg=/etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf
tmp=/etc/sysctl.d/.99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf.tmp
printf '%s\n' \
  '# Disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects and source-routed packets.' \
  'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0' \
  'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0' \
  'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0' \
  'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0' > "$tmp"
chmod 0644 "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$cfg"
sysctl -p "$cfg"
for dir in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do
  [ -d "$dir" ] || continue
  printf '0\n' > "$dir/accept_redirects"
  printf '0\n' > "$dir/accept_source_route"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- installed policy ---'
cat "$cfg"
printf '%s\n' '--- live per-interface state ---'
for path in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do printf '%s=%s\n' "${path#/proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/}" "$(cat "$path")"; done

commands.command:
set -eu
before=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
(sleep 2; reboot) >/dev/null 2>&1 &
printf 'RESTART-SCHEDULED node=%s boot_id_before=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$before"

set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- POST-RESTART BOOT ID ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- RELEASE AND KERNEL ---'
. /etc/os-release
printf 'release=%s kernel=%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME" "$(uname -r)"
printf '%s\n' '--- PERSISTED POLICY AFTER RESTART ---'
cat /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf
printf '%s\n' '--- LIVE HARDENING STATE AFTER RESTART ---'
for path in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do value=$(cat "$path"); printf '%s=%s\n' "${path#/proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/}" "$value"; [ "$value" = 0 ]; done
printf '%s\n' '--- RECOVERED NETWORK HEALTH ---'
ip addr show dev eth0
ip route
rc-service networking status
rc-service sysctl status
ping -c 1 -W 2 "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' 'POST-RESTART-RECOVERY=PASS'
